name: Hemingway App
summary: Hemingway Editor makes your writing bold and clear.
description:
Hemingway Editor makes your writing bold and clear.

Readability Analysis: Highlights complex sentences and suggests simplifications. Sentence Structure: Identifies long or hard-to-read sentences. Passive Voice Detection: Points out passive constructions for revision. Adverb Highlighting: Flags excessive use of adverbs to tighten prose.
